mentions.name: KeibiDrop
mentions.description: A peer-to-peer latency-hiding filesystem that lets users work on shared files instantly without uploading or downloading them. Recent work hardened bidirectional edits so video assets can be worked on directly in applications like Premiere Pro and DaVinci. The pre-alpha release splits congestion control over QUIC, transfers bulk data over TCP, and uses lockless conflict resolution.
mentions.problem: Network latency from uploading and downloading shared files when collaborating; KeibiDrop hides latency so shared files can be worked on instantly.
mentions.source_excerpt:
KeibiDrop: A Peer to Peer Network latency hiding filesystem:

You can work on shared files instantly without uploading or downloading them.
